source: Raspberry Pi Camera Module v2 mechanical drawing (Raspberry Pi, 'Camera Module 2 mechanical drawing'): PCB 25 x 24 mm, four 2.2 mm holes on a 21 x 12.5 mm pattern, lens 8 mm diameter, overall height about 9 mm (to the lens top, PCB included), 15-way FFC connector on the rear. Sensor field of view (Camera Module 2 datasheet): 62.2 deg horizontal, 48.8 deg vertical. ASSUMED / uncertain: PCB thickness 1.0 mm; holes 2.0 mm from the left/right edges and 2.0 mm from the FFC edge (rows at y = 2.0 and 14.5), lens centred across at x = 12.5 and level with the upper hole row (y = 14.5, +/-0.5); FFC connector 21.0 x 5.5 x 2.0 mm on the rear at the y = 0 edge (+/-0.5).
frame: module: origin at the PCB min corner, PCB bottom at Z = 0, lens looks toward +Z, FFC connector on the rear (-Z) at the -Y edge

hole_from_edge_x.source: assumed: holes 2.0 mm from the left/right edges (21 mm pattern on 25 mm)

hole_from_edge_y.source: assumed: lower hole row 2.0 mm from the FFC edge

total_height.source: datasheet: overall height including the PCB

lens_centre_x.source: datasheet: lens centred across the board

lens_centre_y.source: assumed: lens level with the upper hole row

ffc_height.source: assumed: FFC connector height on the rear

ffc_cable_clear.source: assumed: space behind the board for the ribbon cable bend

fov_clear_margin.source: assumed: clearance around the lens barrel for the viewing aperture at the lens plane

fov_clear_depth.source: assumed: depth of the unobstructed cone in front of the lens

interfaces.source: catalogue data (generalize iteration 001, delta D1): the mounting-hole axis list, the plane the part rests on when seated over its holes, and the plane its component keep-out starts from

notes: The lens looks along +Z from LENS_POINT. The viewing aperture must clear the field of view, not just the lens: the fov_aperture keepout is a cylinder of lens_diameter + 2 mm over fov_clear_depth (10 mm) in front of the lens; a front wall of thickness t whose hole is at the lens plane needs a hole of at least lens_diameter + 2 * (distance from the lens top) * tan(31.1 deg) horizontally (62.2 deg) and tan(24.4 deg) vertically (48.8 deg) to avoid vignetting; the wall hole may be the fov_aperture diameter only when the wall is flush with the lens top (distance about 0). The FFC ribbon leaves the rear at the y = 0 edge and needs ffc_cable_clear (8 mm) behind the board (ffc_cable keepout). The hole pattern is two pairs 21 mm apart across the width, so the board is fixed by 4 screws M2 (2.2 mm holes) or posts with a 2.0 mm pin. Import gate: R1 bbox 25 x 24 x 11 (the 9 mm overall height of the datasheet plus the 2.0 mm assumed FFC connector below the PCB; datasheet_size = total_height + ffc_height); R2 hole pitch 21 x 12.5, diameter 2.2; R9 skipped.
